highlight.name: Blue
highlight.use: Sparingly, for a focal point: one small element that should catch the eye.

scenes.headline: One Hand, Two Wheels
scenes.angle: very low worm's-eye looking up from the road surface
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean ink line and flat colour, fine slightly worn black contour lines, one cel-shadow tone per surface, risograph print feel with paper grain. Very low worm's-eye view from the tarmac looking up at a small motorbike speeding past with a rider and a passenger behind him, the passenger leaning out and stretching one arm high to catch a small cricket ball, hand drawn with correct anatomy: five fingers, natural knuckles, full-length thumb. Simple calm faces, dramatic perspective, foreshortened wheels, short hatched texture on the road, hard-edged shadow shapes. The ball is the only #2987F1 element, small and bright. All else uses only #F1592A, #FFDCD1, #7D6E69, #3A1004, #000000 and #FFFFFF with tints and shades. The top 25% of the image is plain flat #FFDCD1 with no detail, no clouds, no lines. Portrait 1:1.41. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.headline: The Ball Never Landed
scenes.angle: lone object in a big sky, high-contrast far-below view
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean ink line and flat colour, fine slightly worn black contour lines, one cel-shadow tone per surface, stepped-band sky gradient, risograph print feel with paper grain. A vast stepped-band sky in #F1592A fading to #FFDCD1 with a single small cricket ball arcing high above, drawn with a short curved motion trail; this ball is the only #2987F1 element. Far below at the lower edge, tiny stadium floodlight towers and a rooftop of a cricket ground in #3A1004 and #7D6E69 silhouette with thin ink detail, and a minute motorbike on a road with a passenger's raised arm. Big simple space against small precise detail, cinematic and quietly humorous. Palette only #F1592A, #FFDCD1, #7D6E69, #3A1004, #000000, #FFFFFF with tints and shades. The bottom 28% of the image is plain flat #3A1004 colour with no detail, no lines. Portrait 1:1.41. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.headline: Caught Between Road and Rope
scenes.angle: very high looking down, near-overhead view
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean ink line and flat colour, fine slightly worn black contour lines, one cel-shadow tone per surface, thin-line hatching on grass, risograph print feel with paper grain. Very high overhead view looking straight down on a cricket ground edge: a curved white boundary rope across short hatched grass in #FFDCD1 and #7D6E69 tints, and just beyond it a road running across the middle of the image with a small motorbike carrying two riders, the passenger's arm raised one-handed with correct anatomy, five fingers and full-length thumb. Hard-edged long shadows of the riders and bike on the tarmac. A tiny cricket ball in #2987F1 near the raised hand is the only blue element. Palette only #F1592A, #FFDCD1, #7D6E69, #3A1004, #000000, #FFFFFF with tints and shades. The top 18% and bottom 18% of the image are plain flat #F1592A colour with no detail or lines. Portrait 1:1.41. No text, letters, logos or signatures.
